reviews.author: Chen Chan
reviews.text:
I’ve been to almost every gym in this area, but Core Craze Gym is the one I decided to stay with. The difference is easy to notice. The trainers are friendly, experienced, and always ready to help without making you feel uncomfortable. They genuinely care about your progress and are happy to answer questions or give advice.The gym is always clean, the equipment is well maintained, and the atmosphere is really positive. It never feels overcrowded or unorganized, which makes every workout enjoyable.
I’m glad I joined Core Craze Gym, and I would definitely recommend it to anyone looking for a clean gym with great trainers and a welcoming environment. Keep up the great work!

reviews.author: Mahmoud Ibrahiem maky
reviews.text: Core Craze fitness club is about a 10-minute walk from the metro and a bit tricky to locate at first. The gym is small and doesn’t have a large number of machines, but the equipment available is in very good condition. The atmosphere is nice, and one unique thing is the Indian music playing, which gives the place a different vibe. The staff are helpful and professional—they assisted with booking my trial session, explained the offers, helped me inside the gym, and guided me through using the equipment and lockers. The gym is generally clean, but the shower room wasn’t as clean as expected, and there was some dust between machines. Overall, it’s an acceptable gym if you live nearby and want good equipment in a small space, but it may not be the best option for someone looking for a wide or fully equipped workout area.
reviews.owner_reply: Thank you for the detailed feedback, Mahmoud! We're glad you enjoyed our equipment, staff support, and vibe. We've noted your comments regarding cleanliness and are addressing those areas right away to make improvements. Hope to see you again soon! 💪

reviews.author: Aju Ajmal
reviews.text:
I’ve been coming to Core Craze Gym Fitness Club for several months now, and I couldn’t be more pleased. The gym offers an excellent selection of modern equipment — everything from free weights to machines and cardio gear — so no matter what workout I’m planning, I always find what I need.

Cleanliness is top‑notch: the floors, bathrooms, and workout areas are well maintained. Staff are friendly, professional, and always willing to help with technique or suggestions if you ask — it makes a big difference, especially as a newer gym‑goer.

The atmosphere is welcoming and motivating without being overwhelming: good music, well‑ventilated space, sensible crowding so you’re not waiting ages for a machine. Flexible hours are a plus — I can show up early or late and still get a good workout.

What I appreciate most is how responsive management is to feedback. If something needs fixing (a loose handle, a worn out mat, etc.), it’s dealt with promptly. Overall, great value for the membership in terms of facilities, support, and environment. Highly recommend for anyone serious about fitness or just wanting a gym where you feel at ease.
reviews.owner_reply: Thanks for sharing your experience 🙌❤️
